verdict.rationale: IRCC's own site has a published section on accounts (GCKey, representatives, employers) and biometrics [ircc-docs-8], so account, credential and identity-proofing topics are documented upfront. Its pre-start questionnaires [ircc-docs-1, ircc-docs-9] cover eligibility and program type rather than these steps. The evidence is only a navigation-level mention, with no proof that the exact sequence is stated before a founder starts filing. missing for 10: an explicit per-application list of required account, credential and identity-proofing steps shown before starting, evidence that these steps are not discovered mid-flow, founder or Start-up Visa-specific prerequisite disclosure, independent or hands-on corroboration.
